description: Launch a memecoin on the aeX402 launchpad on Robinhood Chain (EVM 4663) for a FIXED rising bonding curve (1B supply, starts 0.000008 USDG and climbs ~3.6x, graduates at 10,000 USDG raised, quoted in USDG; the pool then opens just above the last sale price). You supply only identity — name + ticker (+ optional description/image/links). DEFAULT (custodial): the aeX402 backend SIGNS + SUBMITS the createVPool tx for you, so a claude.ai user with NO WALLET can launch in one call; returns {ok,status,txHash,vpId}. Optionally pass `creator` (a 0x address) to record as the coin owner. Pass build:true instead to get an UNSIGNED tx {to,value,data} to submit yourself (non-custodial — that requires `creator` and makes you the on-chain creator). A custodial call SIMULATES first, so a failure burns no gas: status "gated" means createVPool reverts in simulation (cause not determined — likeliest are the ticker still being claimed by a bonding coin or this vpId being taken; see `detail`/`revertData`), and status "unreachable" means the chain could not be reached, which is retryable. The launchpad is NOT chain-gated: createVPool simulates clean from an arbitrary sender (measured 2026-09-25).

build.description: If true, return an UNSIGNED tx to submit yourself (non-custodial) instead of the backend launching for you. Default false.

creator.description: OPTIONAL 0x EVM address recorded as the coin owner (and seeds the vpId). REQUIRED only when build:true (then it is the self-signing on-chain creator).

image.description: Image URL (https:// or ipfs:// only) — off-chain metadata

links.description: Up to 3 links (https:// or ipfs:// only) — off-chain metadata

pad.description: OPTIONAL aeX402 launchpad slug the coin is launched on. Its vpId then starts with that pad's tag, so the pad lists it. Applies on BOTH the custodial (default) and build:true paths

name: launch_token

data.description: build mode: createVPool calldata to submit

metadata.description: Off-chain metadata (stored server-side in custodial mode)

ok.description: Custodial mode: whether the launch was submitted

signMetadata.description: build mode: how the creator signs `metadata` so nobody can claim the coin page first (C103)

how.description: the POST body and the retry rule

message.description: the exact text to personal_sign, with {ts} replaced by the current time in ms

status.description: submitted | gated | custodial-disabled | exists | rate-limited | insufficient-gas | submit-failed

txHash.description: Custodial mode: the createVPool tx hash
